bug.name: bug

workflow.name: bug
workflow.description: Reproduce a bug, fix it test-first, review it, integrate it into the story branch.

reproduce.instructions: Reproduce the reported bug as a user. Record the exact repro and evidence; do not fix anything.

reproduced.means: the bug was observed; repro and evidence attached

cannot_reproduce.means: followed the report faithfully and the bug did not occur; what was tried is attached

implement.instructions: Start from the repro: turn it into a failing test before changing any code.

done.means: the repro (and each rework point) is a passing test

approve.means: the fix addresses the cause, no blocking findings

done.means: conflicts resolved keeping the intent of both sides; tests pass

bug.source:
# Bug workflow — example installed by `norn init`; edit freely (W1).
# Reproduce first, then fix test-first, check, review and integrate.
# Ends in `integrate`, so it runs on a slice (W8).
# Change `test.run` to your repo's test command.
name: bug
description: Reproduce a bug, fix it test-first, review it, integrate it into the story branch.
start: reproduce
steps:
  reproduce:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-qa
    inputs: [slice, spec, handoff]
    instructions: "Reproduce the reported bug as a user. Record the exact repro and evidence; do not fix anything."
    outcomes:
      reproduced:       { to: implement, means: "the bug was observed; repro and evidence attached" }
      cannot_reproduce: { to: $stuck, means: "followed the report faithfully and the bug did not occur; what was tried is attached" }
  implement:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-implement
    inputs: [slice, spec, handoff, last_check, last_findings]
    instructions: "Start from the repro: turn it into a failing test before changing any code."
    outcomes:
      done: { to: test, means: "the repro (and each rework point) is a passing test" }
  test:
    type: check
    run: bun test
    timeout: 10m
    outcomes: { pass: review, fail: { to: implement, counter: test_loop } }
  review:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-review
    inputs: [slice, spec, diff]
    outcomes:
      approve:           { to: integrate, means: "the fix addresses the cause, no blocking findings" }
      changes_requested: { to: implement, counter: review_loop, means: "blocking findings in the receipt" }
  integrate:
    type: git
    action: integrate
    outcomes: { done: $done, conflict: { to: merge, counter: conflict_loop } }
  merge:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-merge
    inputs: [slice, spec]
    outcomes: { done: { to: integrate, means: "conflicts resolved keeping the intent of both sides; tests pass" } }
counters: { test_loop: { max: 5 }, review_loop: { max: 3 }, conflict_loop: { max: 2 } }

done.means: every acceptance criterion (or rework point) has a passing test

approve.means: all criteria met, no blocking findings

fail.means: a criterion fails; repro in findings

slice.source:
# Slice workflow — example installed by `norn init`; edit freely (W1).
# Runs on a slice: build test-first, check, review, QA, then integrate into the story branch.
# QA reports a verdict per acceptance criterion (criteria: required); each outcome is allowed only
# when the worst verdict matches it (verdict:) — `unverified` (could not check here) goes to a person.
# Change `test.run` to your repo's test command.
name: slice
description: Build one slice test-first, verify it, and integrate it into the story branch.
start: implement
steps:
  implement:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-implement
    inputs: [slice, spec, handoff, last_check, last_findings]
    outcomes: { done: { to: test, means: "every acceptance criterion (or rework point) has a passing test" } }
  test:
    type: check
    run: bun test
    timeout: 10m
    outcomes: { pass: review, fail: { to: implement, counter: test_loop } }
  review:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-review
    inputs: [slice, spec, diff]
    outcomes:
      approve:           { to: qa, means: "all criteria met, no blocking findings" }
      changes_requested: { to: implement, counter: review_loop, means: "blocking findings in the receipt" }
  qa:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-qa
    inputs: [slice, spec, diff]
    criteria: required
    outcomes:
      pass:       { to: integrate, verdict: pass, means: "every criterion observed with evidence" }
      fail:       { to: implement, counter: qa_loop, verdict: fail, means: "a criterion fails; repro in findings" }
      partial:    { to: human-qa, verdict: person, means: "criteria only a person can judge, evidence prepared" }
      unverified: { to: human-qa, verdict: unverified, means: "criteria this session could not check; how to check each one is in the report" }
  human-qa:
    type: gate
    prompt: "Check the criteria QA could not settle (listed with how to check each). Approve, or reject with what failed."
    outcomes: { approve: integrate, reject: { to: implement, counter: qa_loop } }
  integrate:
    type: git
    action: integrate
    outcomes: { done: $done, conflict: { to: merge, counter: conflict_loop } }
  merge:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-merge
    inputs: [slice, spec]
    outcomes: { done: { to: integrate, means: "conflicts resolved keeping the intent of both sides; tests pass" } }
counters: { test_loop: { max: 5 }, review_loop: { max: 3 }, qa_loop: { max: 2 }, conflict_loop: { max: 2 } }

story.name: story

workflow.name: story
workflow.description: Default story lifecycle — spec, plan, slices, story-level verification, draft PR.

refine.instructions: Write the spec into the body of story.md; keep its frontmatter unchanged.

done.means: spec complete: problem, solution, numbered Behaviour items with examples, out of scope; no open questions

questions.means: spec written, but open questions are listed that need the person's answers

done.means: every open question is answered and folded into the spec

plan.instructions: Write the Plan section of story.md.

done.means: story.md's Plan section has seams, a coverage table for every Behaviour item, prefactoring, decisions and risks

slice.instructions: Write slice files to slices/<nn>-<slug>.md in the spec folder.

done.means: slice files written; every Behaviour item is covered by some slice's acceptance

approve-plan.prompt: Review the Plan section in story.md and the slice files (edit them if needed). Approve to start the slices, or reject with what to change.

resolve.instructions: Base mode: merge the base commit named in Rework into the story branch in this worktree, resolve, commit the merge; never rebase.

done.means: base merged into the story branch, conflicts resolved and committed

pass.means: every acceptance criterion of the story observed with evidence

fail.means: a criterion fails; repro in findings

partial.means: criteria only a person can judge, evidence prepared

unverified.means: criteria this session could not check; how to check each one is in the report

human-qa.prompt: Check the criteria QA could not settle (listed with how to check each). Approve, or reject with what failed.

done.means: every rework point has a passing test

ready.prompt: Read the draft PR. Approve to mark the story finished (a person still merges the PR), or reject with what to change.

story.source:
# Story workflow — example installed by `norn init`; edit freely (W1).
# Refine and plan with a person, cut slices, approve the plan, run the slices,
# bring the story up to date with its base, verify the whole story, open the draft PR,
# and wait for a person to call it ready.
# Rework found by the story-level test or QA is done in the story worktree.
# QA reports a verdict per acceptance criterion (criteria: required) and may only report the outcome
# matching its worst verdict; `unverified` (could not check here) goes to a person at human-qa.
# A story waiting at human-qa or ready goes back through update when the base moved
# under it in a way that conflicts (base.stale; `behind` re-updates on any base commit).
# Change `test.run` to your repo's test command.
name: story
description: Default story lifecycle — spec, plan, slices, story-level verification, draft PR.
start: refine
steps:
  refine:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-refine
    attended: true
    inputs: [spec, handoff]
    instructions: "Write the spec into the body of story.md; keep its frontmatter unchanged."
    outcomes:
      done:      { to: plan, means: "spec complete: problem, solution, numbered Behaviour items with examples, out of scope; no open questions" }
      questions: { to: clarify, means: "spec written, but open questions are listed that need the person's answers" }
  clarify:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-clarify
    attended: true
    inputs: [spec, handoff]
    outcomes:
      done: { to: plan, means: "every open question is answered and folded into the spec" }
  plan:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-plan
    attended: true
    inputs: [spec, handoff]
    instructions: "Write the Plan section of story.md."
    outcomes:
      done: { to: slice, means: "story.md's Plan section has seams, a coverage table for every Behaviour item, prefactoring, decisions and risks" }
  slice:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-slice
    inputs: [spec, slices]
    instructions: "Write slice files to slices/<nn>-<slug>.md in the spec folder."
    outcomes:
      done: { to: approve-plan, means: "slice files written; every Behaviour item is covered by some slice's acceptance" }
  approve-plan:
    type: gate
    prompt: "Review the Plan section in story.md and the slice files (edit them if needed). Approve to start the slices, or reject with what to change."
    outcomes: { approve: slices, reject: { to: plan, counter: plan_loop } }
  slices:
    type: slices
    outcomes: { done: update, stuck: $stuck }
  update:
    type: git
    action: update
    outcomes: { done: test, conflict: { to: resolve, counter: base_conflict_loop } }
  resolve:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-merge
    inputs: [spec, handoff]
    instructions: "Base mode: merge the base commit named in Rework into the story branch in this worktree, resolve, commit the merge; never rebase."
    outcomes:
      done: { to: update, means: "base merged into the story branch, conflicts resolved and committed" }
  test:
    type: check
    run: bun test
    timeout: 15m
    outcomes: { pass: qa, fail: { to: implement, counter: test_loop } }
  qa:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-qa
    inputs: [spec, slices, diff]
    criteria: required
    outcomes:
      pass:       { to: open-pr, verdict: pass, means: "every acceptance criterion of the story observed with evidence" }
      fail:       { to: implement, counter: qa_loop, verdict: fail, means: "a criterion fails; repro in findings" }
      partial:    { to: human-qa, verdict: person, means: "criteria only a person can judge, evidence prepared" }
      unverified: { to: human-qa, verdict: unverified, means: "criteria this session could not check; how to check each one is in the report" }
  human-qa:
    type: gate
    prompt: "Check the criteria QA could not settle (listed with how to check each). Approve, or reject with what failed."
    outcomes:
      approve: open-pr
      reject:  { to: implement, counter: qa_loop }
      stale:   { to: update, counter: stale_loop }
  implement:
    type: agent
    skill: norn-implement
    inputs: [spec, handoff, last_check, last_findings]
    outcomes:
      done: { to: test, means: "every rework point has a passing test" }
  open-pr:
    type: git
    action: open-pr
    outcomes: { done: ready }
  ready:
    type: gate
    prompt: "Read the draft PR. Approve to mark the story finished (a person still merges the PR), or reject with what to change."
    outcomes:
      approve: $done
      reject:  { to: implement, counter: ready_loop }
      stale:   { to: update, counter: stale_loop }
counters:
  plan_loop: { max: 3 }
  test_loop: { max: 5 }
  qa_loop: { max: 2 }
  ready_loop: { max: 2 }
  # resets each time update merges cleanly: only repeated conflicts on one base move count (W4)
  base_conflict_loop: { max: 2, reset_on: update.done }
  # a stale re-entry is progress from outside (a sibling merged), bounded by the sibling merges
  stale_loop: { max: 10 }
base: { stale: conflict }

action.reason: ready: a person starts an agent and runs norn brief
